generatedBy: TW-Audio lane (LOCAL box), 2026-07-22 - production lane only; holds no game-build lease; embeds nothing
encoderNote: Identical binary + flags as alpha3_2 set: tools/audio/bin/ffmpeg.exe (FFmpeg 6.0, SHA-256 e9fd5e711debab9d680955fc1e38a2c1160fd280b144476cc3f62bc43ef49db1), libvorbis -qscale:a 4 -ac 1 -map_metadata -1. Encode is not bit-reproducible; the committed OGGs + oggSha256 below ARE the fixed deterministic build input (GOV-58 encode-once + assembler architecture).

authority.parseRule: decisions[take] === 'approved' only (SFX-57 binding rules); never familyStatus, never prose counts

scope: ROUND 1 ONLY - all 206 owner-approved takes. 85 carried unchanged from alpha3_2 set (wired families), 121 newly encoded (46 families awaiting call sites). No Round-2/generation-4 take is included (frozen export predates generation 4).
deviations: 15 source WAVs are stereo (cues 079/080/081/089/091/092); encoded mono per the fixed -ac 1 contract for set consistency and byte cost. Stereo masters untouched in assets/audio/_review; a stereo re-encode is a data-file change if the owner wants it.
assemblerRules: Clips with engineKey null MUST NOT be auto-grouped into TW_SAMPLE_DATA until the game-build lease assigns a call site (see SFX-52 wiring spec). Embedding them without a dispatch edit produces dead bytes.
Verify every oggSha256 before embedding (same gate as 54_BUILD_ALPHA3_2_AUDIO.py).
Loop-flagged clips (loop:true) are seamless-loop sources; play via AudioBufferSourceNode.loop=true. Verify loop-boundary continuity by ear post-embed.
Tier 7 (deferredTier:true) remains drop-first if decode-time/memory strain (SFX-57 cut order).
